migration.description: Adopt recoverable content-read mismatch state and canonical final-object revalidation for the integrated artifact publication schema.
migration.release_unit_description: Phase-one artifact content-recovery candidate; the ordered marker changes recovery behavior without rewriting migration 00007.

compatibility_assessment.reason: The existing REST and MCP artifact operations retain their shapes; content-read replacement races are classified as conflicts, while a stable mismatch may enter the additive content-mismatch unavailable reason already permitted by migration 00007. Earlier candidates can read that existing state and fail closed, while only the recovery-capable candidate repairs it; the candidate reads existing 00007 rows without rewriting them.

durable_state.description: A stable bounded content-read mismatch records unavailable_reason=content-mismatch and a bounded recovery deadline. Recovery revalidates the canonical final object and restores ready only after valid bytes are observed; staging bytes are not treated as a backup and remain governed by the existing identity-checked reclamation rules.
durable_state.storage_implementation: Existing PostgreSQL conversation_artifacts columns and the dedicated immutable artifact object directory created by migration 00007; this marker adds no table, column, index or data rewrite.

source_compatibility_range.from_program_versions: Phase-one candidate containing migration 00007 but not the ordered content-recovery marker.
source_compatibility_range.to_program_version: Phase-one candidate containing migration 00015 and the content-recovery implementation.
source_compatibility_range.compatibility_boundary: The marker adds no schema shape and earlier artifact processes can continue to read existing rows, treating content-mismatch as unavailable rather than serving unverified bytes. They do not repair that state, so a recovery-capable candidate must remain available for repair; blue-green staging may overlap the older process, and switchback remains fail-closed without reversing the migration.

progress_signals: Goose records the ordered 00015 marker without modifying migration 00007 or rewriting existing artifact rows.

A content-read mismatch is quarantined only after both the opened descriptor and canonical object path are confirmed unchanged; a replacement race returns content-changed and leaves the ready row untouched.
Recovery revalidates the canonical final object and restores ready only after valid bytes are observed, with bounded retry deferral for unresolved inspection.
pause_points: After the 00015 marker commits and before admitting recovery-capable artifact reads.
After a content-mismatch row is observed and before enabling the next bounded recovery pass.

recovery.faulty_release_recovery: forward-repair-by-a-new-program-version-and-new-ordered-migration; content-mismatch rows remain unavailable until canonical final-object validation succeeds

required_test_evidence: A final content-read mismatch is rechecked against the opened descriptor and canonical object path, returns content-changed without quarantining after a file-replacement race, and stable corruption enters content-mismatch recovery.
A content-mismatch recovery pass restores ready only after a later valid final-object inspection; existing staging reclamation remains identity-checked and does not use staging as a content backup.
The 00015 marker is recognized idempotently, migration 00007 remains byte-for-byte immutable, and no down migration reverses durable artifact state.
